data: Pinned v4 frontier manifest; original questions and choices; image pixels resized to the same 1536 longest-side limit then encoded losslessly as PNG
selection: All 448 MMLU-Pro audit cases and 20 per MMStar category sorted by stable_rank(id), 120 images. Maximum-capability pilot takes the first one per category from these subsets: 14 text and 6 visual questions.

astra-medium.role: Small reasoning-enabled capability pilot; not evidence of broad frontier parity

output: Strict JSON schema containing one original-choice letter; no generated confidence passed off as calibrated probabilities
timing: Local media decode/resize/PNG encoding plus HTTP request through final response; network and provider work included; individual runs at concurrency one
cost: Compute a conservative reservation before every request. Charge all returned usage at uncached standard prices for an upper estimate; record actual usage fields. Count incomplete responses as failures. No automatic retries after uncertain charges.
error_policy: A transport, authentication, quota or model-access error stops the paid run; preserve completed records and account for all remaining cases as not run. Do not silently substitute a model.
limitations: Twenty Astra cases are a pilot, not a statistically powered capability comparison
A bounded reasoning output can truncate; report the count and never describe it as unlimited reasoning
These GPT-6 endpoints do not accept native audio; no transcript substitution
Local MiSO pipeline latency is not directly comparable with hosted API client latency
